label: OpenAI Realtime 2
description: Pay-per-use Global Standard realtime deployment. Batch tests decode each clip to PCM and request text-only transcription over the Realtime WebSocket API.

label: OpenAI Realtime 2.1
description: Pay-per-use Global Standard preview realtime deployment with improved silence and noise handling. Batch tests request text-only transcription over the Realtime WebSocket API.

label: OpenAI Realtime 2.1 mini
description: Cost-efficient GA sibling of Realtime 2.1 (2026-07-07). Batch tests decode each clip to PCM and request text-only output over the Realtime WebSocket API.

label: OpenAI Realtime 1.5
description: GA realtime speech-to-speech model (2026-02-23), the predecessor of the Realtime 2 family. Text-only output over the Realtime WebSocket API.

label: OpenAI Audio 1.5
description: Turn-based audio chat model (2026-02-23) over Chat Completions with input_audio. Follows instructions like a chat model and supports two-pass follow-up turns.

label: OpenAI Audio mini
description: Lower-cost turn-based audio chat model (2025-12-15) over Chat Completions with input_audio.

label: OpenAI Transcribe
description: Speech-to-text model (2026-07-28) via /audio/transcriptions. The prompt is used as context (dialect name and example sentences), not as instructions; no two-pass support.

label: GPT-4o Transcribe
description: GPT-4o speech-to-text model (2025-03-20) via /audio/transcriptions. The prompt is used as context; no two-pass support.

label: GPT-4o mini Transcribe
description: Lower-cost GPT-4o mini speech-to-text model (2025-12-15) via /audio/transcriptions. The prompt is used as context; no two-pass support.

label: Whisper
description: Classic Whisper speech-to-text model (Standard regional deployment) via /audio/transcriptions. Only the last 224 prompt tokens are used; no two-pass support.

label: Multi-model ensemble
deployment: Realtime 2.1 + GPT-4o Transcribe + GPT Transcribe, fused by the refiner
description: Virtual model for the Ensemble strategy: hears each clip once with each member model (dialect-guided prompts) and fuses the hypotheses with BENCHMARK_REFINER_DEPLOYMENT. Members with pass 'target' answer in the run's task; 'dialect' always transcribes the dialect.
